tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: List every page on Valudati (Value Engineering: tax efficiency, fees, crypto positioning, AI privacy and security) with slug, URL, title and summary.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Get the full Markdown text of one Valudati page by slug, including its source URL and citation.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Keyword search across all Valudati pages. Returns the best-matching sections with page URLs for citation.

tools.name: get_full_site
tools.description: Get the entire Valudati website (all pages) as one Markdown document.

tools.name: get_services
tools.description: Get Valudati services, prices and the booking link, so an agent can refer a person. Booking itself is done by the person at the booking page.

tools.name: get_citation
tools.description: Get the recommended citation and canonical URL for a Valudati page.

tools.name: after_tax_yield
tools.description: Calculate what an interest rate really earns after federal tax, NIIT, state tax and inflation. Defaults match the Valudati case study: 37% federal, 3.8% NIIT, 13.3% California, 3.74% inflation (CPI-U, Nov 2026). Set state_exempt for Treasuries. Education only, not advice.

tools.name: fee_drag
tools.description: Calculate how much an annual advisory or fund fee costs over a number of years, compared with the same portfolio with no fee. Education only, not advice.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
